question: Do verified intermediate states help inference beyond direct and trained-pause paths, and separately improve the same direct path after training?
scope: Supervised mature-model algorithmic reference. No autonomous discovery, general-language pretraining, novel CoT expressivity or proven internalization claim.
model: Actual released Qwen3-1.7B-Base; fresh identical B0 for all six models.

data.secondary_panels: Original first1024families/2048questions each in DEV_interpolation and DEV_depth; byte-identical original cohorts.
data.map_scope: New complete maps, elementary edges may repeat. Simple paths only, not arbitrary cycles. rsrs/srsr motifs absent from TRAIN; longer7–10 excludes these motifs.
data.paired_units: Two counterfactual variants per family, bootstrap whole families.

arms.trace: 50%direct/50%ordinary full verified CoT, including root operation
arms.pause: 50%direct/50%provided existing FIM-pad inputs;6 per available program step; no pause prediction loss

training.parameter_compute: BF16 with FP32 masters/moments, rotary buffers preservedFP32
training.loss: Separately mean-normalized final-field/EOS weight1 and optional trace-field weight1, per example. Same final-answer labels/coefficient for every arm. No ordinary-source LM component in this laboratory.
training.view_schedule: Within each epoch item-index/epoch parity; each question exactly two direct and two arm-specific exposures.
training.restart: Every run first halts64, independent full-state/order/mask checks, then planned fresh-process restore64→4096. Terminal4096 primary;64 development milestone only.
training.selection: No held model outcomes before all six terminal checkpoints. No performance early stopping, checkpoint selection, LR/weight/prompt sweep.

primary_claims.inference: For each of two data-order seeds: trace generated answers versus matched direct model, matched trained-pause inference, and same trace model direct path. Each point gain>=3pp and paired family-bootstrap95% lower>0. Six comparisons required; report each separately.
primary_claims.training: For each seed, trace-trained direct versus direct-trained direct and pause-trained direct. Same practical/interval threshold, evaluated separately; inference failure does not erase training benefit.
primary_claims.interpretation: Evaluate the two claim families separately. A missed gate is not proof of zero effect. Beating provided pauses does not establish dominance over every compute alternative or equal latency.

metrics.primary: Free complete-node answers. Gold-independent fixed parser, node case/whitespace harmless. Errors, caps and unsupported outputs stay in all denominators.
metrics.bootstrap: Resample complete two-variant families;5000draws, fixedseed17. Checkpoint-conditional95% intervals, not broad model/seed uncertainty. Never treat paired variants as independent.
secondary: Interpolation and longer lengths separately; per-depth and per-program tables.
Same-reader empty versus own traces; complete/correct intermediate execution and natural stops.
Both counterfactual variants correct; do not count twins as independent.
Fixed hash512composition families for exact root-excluded partial/corrupt/intact donor controls; no outcome choice.
Semantic-node/full-answer likelihood diagnostics if executed remain secondary and cannot replace complete-answer gates.
Ordinary-text retention diagnostic remains separate; this experiment is task SFT, not a general pretraining win.
Actual source exposures, labelled tokens, supplied positions, generated actions, checkpoint/startup/training and evaluation wall/chip costs.
metrics.base_reference: Untouched B0 on the original1024-family subsets, direct and conventional CoT. Use one fixed hash-selected TRAIN depth1 worked example for task serialization, no prompt sweep. This is a stronger task-format reference, not a primary matched-training contrast.
metrics.cost_scope: Same static training shapes/exposures do not equate information or auxiliary-target counts. Provided causal-prefill pauses and generated tokens have different execution graphs/latency.

power_plan.normal_approximation: Normal approximation only. At9216 independent families, true5pp and conservative family difference variance1, each comparison passage~97.3%, six-comparison union lower~83.5%. Not an observed or exact finite-sample guarantee. At a true3pp effect the point-threshold rule does not approach80% power.

retention.latest_full: One recoverable full state per arm across the two waves. Current EBS-run files are already on EBS, not a second backup or off-instance protection.
retention.intermediate: New V28 periodic payloads may retire only after a newer full-state readback/fsync. Preserve all metrics/manifests/retirement receipts. All historical original states/caches remain untouched.
retention.terminals: Every terminal model stays on EBS. Previous seed terminal optimizer may retire only after that terminal passed independent full-state audit and a new same-arm seed full passes readback.
retention.development64: Preserve all six model64 weights with readback/fsync on NVMe-CPT; developmental, not a primary endpoint.
retention.exports: Global filesystem lease serializes large saves; host phase files avoid waiting inside Neuron device barriers.

budget.resource_floors: 35GiB each involved filesystem,512GiB host available; prelaunch>=768GiB host.
budget.hardware_changes: No package/compiler/cache relocation/cloud/IAM/paid teachers or model-size change.

causal_limit: Complete training recipes differ in auxiliary targets and some answer-training contexts. A positive result is not a pure auxiliary-gradient effect or proven internalization. All arms use causal CE. No autonomous learning or ordinary pretraining claim.
decision: A controlled reference can motivate returning to prefix-to-continuation CPT and guidance withdrawal. It cannot itself confirm V26 or establish autonomous/general pretraining benefit.
